description: This file defines the interface for plugin management functions related to the Cisco Open Service Architecture (COSA). It includes function declarations for initialization, support checking, and unloading of plugin components, along with platform-specific macro definitions.

methods.name: COSA_Init
methods.description: Initializes the COSA plugin with a maximum supported version and plugin info handle.

methods.name: COSA_IsObjSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given object name is supported by the plugin.

methods.name: COSA_Unload
methods.description: Unloads the plugin and performs cleanup.
